MRM25v2.0

This model was prepared for the North Carolina Department of Transportation (NCDOT) 2026-2035 State Transportation Improvement Program (STIP) Development. It is currently being reviewed by North Carolina Department of Air Quality (NCDAQ) and is not official. Release notes will be updated once this model is confirmed for official by NCDAQ and NCDOT.

Key updates from previous model:

Updates to master network, transit routes and project list to support STIP Sets user threads to support matching runs across different computer specs Updates to truck model friction factors.
